_comment: Houdini RFSoC single-UE client. Runs the unmodified receiver.cc client-sync path (clientSyncTxRx -> syncSearch -> find_beacon) on the Houdini radio via the ClientRadioSet houdini backend. Beacon is transmitted separately by beacon_tx_gold from the BS board. Matched-NCO Zone-1 loopback: TX ch1 -> RX ch1, NCO 500 MHz. slot=4096 samps -> detect window ~9544 > beacon. 30 slots x 4096 = 122880 samps = EXACTLY 1 ms per frame so the UE pilot TX time quantizes onto Houdini's whole-ms TX grid at a constant advance.
